personality_traits: blustery and demanding, tries to issue an ultimatum to assert authority
quick to anger, physically rigid and tense rather than relaxed at rest
brittle confidence that collapses the moment he is challenged
old-fashioned/formal appearance (glasses, buttoned coat, tie) suggesting a self-image of quiet authority that the scene undercuts
emotional_range: simmering irritation at the start (furrowed brow, downturned mouth)
aggressive/threatening while delivering the ultimatum, voice straining as if losing power
confused and deflated when his wife calmly dismisses him
open-mouthed, wide-eyed shock/discomfort as he processes being called out
expressions: 0:00 - seated on bed, jaw set, eyebrows angled down in a fixed scowl
0:01-0:04 - scowl deepens, mouth opens into a strained shout shape while saying "Let me go out with the boys, or you will regret this"
0:04 - glasses slightly askew on his nose, giving a slightly deflated/worn look mid-outburst
0:08-0:12 - eyebrows stay angled but eyes widen and mouth hangs ajar in stunned silence as the wife responds, posture unchanged but expression reads as caught off guard
gestures: sits stiffly upright on the edge of the bed, hands planted flat on the mattress bracing himself
leans slightly forward toward his wife while delivering the threat, invading her space
no hand gestures used beyond the bracing posture - the threat is carried entirely through voice and facial tension
remains frozen in the same braced position after speaking, not retreating or softening physically even as his face reacts
characters.interactions_notes: He initiates the confrontation, turning his body and voice toward her while she keeps reading, physically established as the one seeking a reaction. He does not make sustained eye contact until after he has already delivered the line, by which point she has taken control of the exchange.

personality_traits: unbothered and self-possessed, treats her husband's outburst as a minor curiosity rather than a threat
sharp and quietly commanding, dismantles his authority with a single calm request
emotionally composed to the point of appearing detached, prioritizing her book over the conflict
dry, deadpan wit implied by the clipped, understated delivery of her lines
emotional_range: placid, absorbed interest in her book at rest (heavy-lidded, relaxed eyes)
mild, almost clinical amusement ("Interesting.") in response to his threat
calm authority as she issues her own instruction ("Ask again in your normal voice"), eyebrow slightly raised
no visible escalation or distress at any point - emotional range stays narrow and controlled by design, which is the comedic contrast to him
expressions: 0:00 - eyes lowered to the book, soft neutral expression, mouth relaxed
0:08-0:10 - eyes lift toward him unhurriedly, one eyebrow arching slightly as she says "Interesting."
0:10-0:12 - head tilts a little toward him, faint knowing look while delivering "Ask again in your normal voice", mouth barely moving
gestures: holds an open book in both hands throughout, thumb marking her place, never fully lowering it even when addressing him
shifts gaze from the page to him without turning her whole body, keeping her posture settled into the pillows
sits back against the pillows in a relaxed, grounded pose that visually contrasts his forward-leaning tension
characters.interactions_notes: She holds the power position in the scene despite speaking last and least: she barely turns to face him, keeps the book as a barrier/prop, and answers his loud demand with two short, quiet lines that flip the dynamic. Eye contact is asymmetric - he looks at her directly while threatening her, she glances at him only briefly and returns her attention to the book, signaling she was never truly threatened.
